title: feat: add write-once newsletter workflow
body:
## Summary

- add the standalone Omni Platform Newsletter WordPress plugin
- provide a neutral four-section authoring contract for web, email, and duplex print
- integrate Newspack Newsletters and Print My Blog without configuring delivery
- add Composer metadata, contract checks, coding standards, and CI

## Verification

- `composer test`
- `composer validate --no-check-publish`
- `linters-local.sh --changed`

This is the repository bootstrap requested by the maintainer; there is no pre-existing issue to close.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a dedicated newsletter view that organizes content into Sidebar, Front, Back, and Footer sections for web and print.
  * Added a print/save control and print-preview layout with overflow warnings when content exceeds page dimensions.
  * Added a starter newsletter pattern. Email rendering remains unchanged unless all four required sections are present.
* **Documentation**
  * Added plugin documentation covering requirements, supported outputs, integrations, and installation.

title: fix: avoid false print overflow warnings
body:
## Summary

- detect overflow from the complete fixed-size print sheet
- avoid false positives caused by fractional grid-child measurements
- retain visible warnings when content actually expands a sheet

## Verification

- `composer test`
- reproduced the prior false warning with the contained two-page Letter fixture
- blocked `overflow.js` to confirm the same fixture fits as two complete Letter pages

The Bedrock integration will update to this commit and rerun browser/PDF verification before completion.

title: fix: add browser print layout headroom
body:
## Summary

- add additional front-page print headroom for browser font and rounding differences
- bump the asset version to 0.1.3

## Evidence

Chrome 147 print-media measurements at 0.1.2 showed the front main region at 983px scroll height versus 978px client height. This reduces the front hero by 0.15in while preserving the full overflow guard.

## Verification

- `composer test`
- contained two-page PDF and print-media dimensions will be rerun after the Bedrock lock updates to this commit

<!-- aidevops:origin:interactive -->
